endpointNote: This endpoint exposes only the five diagnostic tools below. Signup, onboarding, reports, and ad-unit tools are not on it.

check_https_certificate.returns: structured result with skipped: true when the site could not be reached

check_crawler_blocks.returns: structured result with skipped: true when the site could not be reached

run_agentic_readiness_audit.returns: structured result with skipped: true when the site could not be reached

releaseStatus: Prepared locally; verify the deployed tool schemas before using new inputs.
reportEmail: Optional on the four domain diagnostics. Pass only the recipient the user explicitly specified for requested PDF report delivery. Omit for ordinary diagnostics. Do not infer an address from account identity, headers, metadata, or conversation history. The checklist does not accept it.
emailBehavior: The report is returned in chat whether or not email is requested. An email request sends a PDF of the diagnostic findings through SendGrid with open and click tracking disabled. Report the returned acceptance or failure status accurately; acceptance is not proof of inbox delivery. No CRM lead, marketing signup, or sales outreach is created.
dataHandling: Do not send conversation messages or unrelated inputs. Reports are processed in memory for delivery. Short-lived hashed deduplication and rate-limit records expire within 24 hours; they are not a contact list. Email providers process the recipient and report to deliver the requested message.

emailDelivery.meaning: Present only when email was requested. Provider acceptance is not inbox delivery. Do not silently retry unknown acceptance. not_sent covers failed or skipped diagnostics.
